title: Replication code
summary: Replication code for a statistics paper on inferential fidelity of synthetic data, comparing several tabular generation methods (custom Gaussian-copula code, differential-privacy mechanisms, and SmartNoise) against ML-based synthesizers. The Python generators in generate/ instantiate SDV's CTGANSynthesizer, TVAESynthesizer, GaussianCopulaSynthesizer and CopulaGANSynthesizer via sdv.single_table to produce one family of synthetic datasets for the comparison.
